question: What power does the goddess Kāmākhyā grant to devotees?
premises: Kāmākhyā is identified as that very goddess.
She is described as the bestower of all powers.
inference: Kāmākhyā is the goddess who grants all spiritual accomplishments.
plain_english: O Lady of the gods, Kāmākhyā herself is the bestower of all powers.
